name: Hourglass
description: An hourglass where sand drains from top to bottom, then the glass flips to restart

variations.name: default
variations.description: Sand streams from the top bulb into the bottom one, then the hourglass rotates 180 degrees and drains again

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Color of the glass outline and frame bars

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Fill color of the glass interior

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
